strategy: Check supplied source and artifacts independently, preserve evidence limits, then return a concrete review.

nudges.purpose: Review original evidence rather than the plausibility of report prose.
nudges.deliverable: One concise native review note with decisive source/calculation checks, findings and next proposals.
understanding: Diagnostic execution, product correctness, subject correctness and learner understanding are distinct claims.

do_not: Do not modify or silently reconcile the issued inputs.

success.observable: Source-linked findings with actual reproduced observations and limits.
success.negative_case: A completed diagnostic or correct arithmetic must not become product acceptance or learner evidence.

missing: Formal qualification and actual model configuration.
uncertainty.return_with: Return actual findings and specific missing evidence; leave acceptance unresolved.
independent_work: Source and numerical checks can proceed independently.

required: Actual commands/checks, conclusions, limits and justified continuation.
report.next_action: Designer reconciles affected conclusions and preserves issued history.
